products.name: Sales Intelligence Platform
products.data_scope: Business contact data: names, job titles, professional emails, mobile numbers, employer, LinkedIn URLs. No sensitive personal data collected.
products.notes: Primary SaaS product. Cognism acts as independent data controller for the contact database and as processor for customer-uploaded CRM data. Data sourced from public web and licensed third parties; screened against 15+ global Do-Not-Call lists.

products.name: Data-as-a-Service (DaaS)
products.data_scope: Bulk B2B contact records delivered via API or flat file for CRM enrichment.
products.notes: Separate attestation letters available (Prospector and Sales Companion per trust center). Cognism acts as processor under customer DPA for enrichment workflows.

products.name: Sales Companion
products.data_scope: Real-time contact data lookup via Chrome extension; integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive.
products.notes: Covered by separate attestation letter on trust center. No additional data categories beyond platform scope.

products.name: Kaspr (affiliate product)
products.data_scope: LinkedIn-sourced contact data (acquired by Cognism; operated via Kaspr SAS, France).
products.notes: Separate legal entity (Kaspr SAS, France) listed as Cognism affiliate in privacy policy. Distinct terms apply.

flags: Cognism operates as data controller for its B2B contact database and as processor for customer CRM data. Customers bear responsibility for ensuring downstream lawful basis when using Cognism-sourced contacts for outreach.
GDPR legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f)) is the stated lawful basis for collecting and providing B2B contact data. Data subjects can opt-out via Cognism Privacy Centre at cognism.com/data-opt-out.

AI training posture is not explicitly addressed in the published privacy policy, terms, or trust center. ML models are used internally for data quality but no customer-data AI training statement exists (positive or negative).

No HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CSA STAR, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, or ISO 42001 certifications found. These are not relevant to Cognisms core B2B data use case but should be noted for regulated-industry buyers.
DPA is available (PDF at cognism.com/hubfs/customer-terms-DPA.pdf) but must be requested and executed separately; it is not automatically bundled into standard subscriptions.
Kaspr SAS (France) is a separate Cognism affiliate with potentially distinct data practices; buyers using Kaspr should review its own terms independently.
Trust center (trust.cognism.com) requires an access request for full document downloads (SOC 2 report, ISO certificates); publicly accessible summary is available without login.
